approvals.reason: The sequence was an unbounded int64 while the web client, the only first-party caller, represents it as a JavaScript number; a value above 2^53-1 could not be echoed back exactly on a stale refusal. No first-party client sends values near the bound; silo-apple and silo-android do not call these operations.
